lead.headline: Flat Space Entanglement from Wedge Holography
body: We study holographic entanglement entropy in three-dimensional flat space by combining wedge holography with a controlled flat limit of AdS end-of-the-world branes. The limit takes a wedge of AdS$_4$ bounded by two AdS$_3$ branes to a Randall-Sundrum-like configuration of two flat branes, and the entanglement entropy of an interval in the two-dimensional corner CFT becomes that of an interval at null infinity of the branes.

The result has the functional form of the entanglement entropy of a two-dimensional Carrollian CFT, the proposed holographic dual of gravity in asymptotically flat three-dimensional spacetimes. However, the inferred central charges yield $c_M=0$ and $c_L\to\infty$ in the flat limit.
Adding a gravitational Chern-Simons term produces a $c_M$-like contribution, but we still find $c_L\to\infty$ and $c_M\to0$ in this limit.
lead.authors: Robert C. Myers and Bruno Sivilotti

features.headline: The Relaxation of Quantum Near-Extremal Black Holes. (I) Microcanonical States, Pruning of Quasinormal Modes, and the Aretakis Instability
body: The late-time relaxation of a near-extremal black hole is classically governed by an infinite tower of purely damped quasinormal modes. This poses a puzzle: the higher overtones decay at rates much larger than the energy $E$ of the black hole above extremality, so they would need black hole states below the extremal mass.
We resolve it by including the quantum fluctuations that become large when $E$ falls below a scale $E_b$.

features.headline: Anomalies and the Berry Phase: From $π^0\toγγ$ to the geometry of the fermion vacuum
body: We review the chiral anomaly from a historical perspective, from the $π^0\toγγ$ puzzle and the work of Adler, Bell and Jackiw, to the Wess-Zumino-Witten (WZW) term. We then describe how the WZW term was motivated from quantum chromodynamics in 1983-85.

Integrating out the non-Abelian gauge fields, that have a gapped spectrum, gives a Nambu-Jona-Lasinio type theory of quarks, and integrating out the quarks, which are gapped by chiral symmetry breaking, gives the WZW model.

features.headline: $AdS$ Leading Regge Trajectory from String Field Theory
body: We determine the $AdS$ mass of the leading Regge trajectory in superstring backgrounds $AdS_5\times S^5$, $AdS_4\times\mathbb{CP}^3$, and $AdS_3\times S^3\times{\cal M}_4$ with pure Ramond-Ramond (RR) flux for both ${\cal M}_4=S^3\times S^1$ and ${\cal M}_4=T^4$, to the second order in the expansion with respect to the background RR flux by solving the linearized equations of motion in closed superstring field theory.

stories.headline: Inflation at strong mixing as a connection problem: effective field theory, Stokes phenomenon and the cosmological collider
body: We study a massive field strongly mixed with the curvature perturbation during inflation, in the regime where the latter is described at low energies by a single-field effective field theory (EFT) with a quadratic dispersion relation. What this EFT captures, and what lies beyond it, are encoded in a connection problem, which relates the solutions that define the vacuum at early times to those that describe observables at late times.

stories.headline: The Schwarzschild-Kerr crossover of high overtone quasinormal modes
body: A slowly rotating black hole is close to a nonrotating one, but its highly damped quasinormal spectrum is not. The Schwarzschild approximation holds only up to overtone numbers of order $χ^{-4/3}$, where $χ$ is the dimensionless spin.
We find that the frequency shift at this scale is a universal function, derived from the wave boundary conditions with an error estimate.

stories.headline: Differential Equations for Feynman Integrals from Higher Residue Pairings
body: We develop a method for constructing differential equations for Feynman integrals directly from multivariate intersection numbers, without fibration. The large-$\varepsilon$ expansion of the intersection pairing, with $\varepsilon$ the dimensional regulator, is given by Saito's higher residue pairings, which localise at the critical points of a potential and admit closed multivariate formulae.

stories.headline: Entanglement structure in conformal Y-junctions
body: We study how entanglement constrains energy transmission in conformal Y-junctions using holographic and free-field models. We define pairwise effective central charges from mutual information as a natural extension of the interface entanglement coefficient.
For holographic junctions, we formulate a branched RT prescription and show that the resulting entropies satisfy monogamy of mutual information.

stories.headline: Elliptic spin Ruijsenaars--Schneider model via the Poisson reduction of the affine Heisenberg double
body: We construct the Hamiltonian structure of the elliptic spin Ruijsenaars--Schneider model with dynamical inhomogeneities by Poisson reduction of the affine Heisenberg double extended by an affine oscillator manifold. This construction extends the Heisenberg double approach to spin Ruijsenaars--Schneider models from the hyperbolic to the elliptic case.

stories.headline: A spin chain as a deformed conformal field theory: an ODE/IM approach
body: The ODE/IM correspondence relates ordinary differential equations to integrable quantum field theories in the continuum. We ask whether it extends to integrable spin chains of finite length $N$.
We analyse the twisted XXZ chain at a special anisotropy and twist, focusing on states in its Lee--Yang scaling sector.

stories.headline: The Hidden Simplicity of the Classical Limit
body: We study the classical limit of two-to-two massive-scalar amplitudes at all orders of perturbation theory. We compute these amplitudes in the probe limit for several theories: a family of scalar theories, electrodynamics, and $\mathcal{N}=8$ supergravity with half-BPS matter.

stories.headline: NS5-branes and the black hole/string transition
body: Near to the onset of BTZ black hole formation in string theory is a large ensemble of 6d BPS supergravity solutions sourced by slightly separated fundamental strings and Neveu-Schwarz fivebranes. We extend the construction of these geometries to include gauge excitations of the fivebranes, and then study the energetics of D-string solitons in relation to the deconfinement transition of little strings, which are the natural non-abelian degrees of freedom that deconfine in the transition to the black hole phase.
stories.authors: Asad Fayiz and Emil J. Martinec

sections.name: Across the Border
sections.note: Papers whose primary category is not hep-th (mostly gr-qc), cross-listed into it

stories.headline: Horizon dynamical entropies and phase space topology
body: We study phase space topologies induced by infinite-dimensional norms as a means to solve the problem of 'integrability' of Hamiltonian generators corresponding to diffeomorphisms of a null hypersurface, with the specific goal in mind to compare different prescriptions for the dynamical entropy of black holes, which replaces the area in non-stationary regimes.

stories.headline: Scalar-tensor interactions selected through their first-order thermodynamic dynamics
body: We investigate the restrictive capability of first-order thermodynamics on scalar-tensor gravity. Starting from a general action containing nonlinear curvature dependence, an Einstein-tensor-Hessian coupling, and independent quadratic and cubic scalar-Hessian interactions, we derive the complete effective-fluid quantities.

stories.headline: Strong hyperbolicity of puncture-gauge formulations of gravitational theories with second order equations of motion
body: We prove that the modified CCZ4 (mCCZ4) formulation, used in nonlinear puncture-gauge simulations of (d+1)-dimensional Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity and four-derivative scalar-tensor theory in four dimensions, is strongly hyperbolic for both theories at sufficiently weak coupling, provided that the gauge parameters are chosen to satisfy a cone-separation condition.

briefs.headline: Hadron structure in $1+1$ dimensions from the infinite Hamiltonian lattice
briefs.text: The internal structure of a hadron is encoded in matrix elements of operators between hadron states of definite momentum.

briefs.headline: Fisher information in the flux landscape
briefs.text: We quantify the fine-tuning of the flux superpotential in Type IIB Calabi-Yau orientifold compactifications using the Fisher Information Metric.

briefs.headline: Holographic Spread Complexity of a Probe Particle with General Initial Data
briefs.text: We investigate the holographic spread complexity of a massive particle probing global AdS$_3$ with general initial data.

briefs.headline: D0-brane bound states in Matrix theory: nonperturbative bounds on matrix extent, noncommutativity and spatial shape
briefs.text: In Matrix theory, a single eleven-dimensional supergraviton is associated with a BPS bound state of D0-branes.

briefs.headline: All the Positive Energy Correlators
briefs.text: We develop a framework to systematically obtain the full set of positivity bounds on multi-point energy correlators for sources of arbitrary spin.

briefs.headline: Radiation from periods: Bremsstrahlung functions, wound loops, latitudes and integral constraints in ABJM
briefs.text: The Bremsstrahlung functions of the 1/2BPS and 1/6BPS Wilson lines of ABJM theory measure their response to small deformations.

briefs.headline: The double copy and perturbative teleparallel gravity
briefs.text: In this paper we analyze the double copy between gluon and graviton amplitudes within the context of teleparallel gravity.

briefs.headline: Scalar perturbations in extremal Reissner-Nordström geometry: new methods at work
briefs.text: We study scalar radiation emitted by a particle moving along a circular orbit around a four-dimensional extremal Reissner-Nordström black hole.

briefs.headline: The Four-Loop Ladder Integral Family for the QED Electron Self-Energy
briefs.text: We compute the complete set of master integrals of the four-loop ladder integral family contributing to the electron self-energy in Quantum Electrodynamics.

briefs.headline: Cosmological Constant Screening from Quantum Horizon Chaos
briefs.text: We propose a microscopic mechanism for screening the cosmological constant through quantum chaos of the horizon degrees of freedom.

briefs.headline: The Wilson-loop formulation of Yang-Mills at finite mode truncation: a Level-Two structural bypass of the Gribov ambiguity
briefs.text: The unfixed real-time Henstock-Kurzweil functional integral for truncated Yang-Mills removes the choice of a gauge surface, but gauge orbits remain objects of the formulation: that is a Level-One bypass of the Gribov ambiguity.

briefs.headline: Romans Mass from a $\mathrm{GL}(1,\mathbb{R})$ Topological Field Theory with Boundary
briefs.text: We construct an eleven-dimensional topological field theory with boundary whose edge modes are the dilaton and form fields of type IIA supergravity, including the Romans mass.
briefs.authors: Euihun Joung and J. A. Rosabal

briefs.headline: M5-branes wrapped on topological disks from maximal 7D gauged supergravity
briefs.text: We study new supersymmetric $AdS_5 \times Σ$ solutions for $Σ$ being a topological disk from the maximal gauged supergravity in seven dimensions with $CSO(p,q,5-p-q)$ gauge groups.

briefs.headline: Beyond the Thermodynamic-Volume Limit in Holographic Complexity
briefs.text: In the large black hole regime, holographic complexity obeys a thermodynamic-volume scaling law, while the finite-size approach to this limit remains unresolved.
briefs.authors: Di Wu and Robert B. Mann

briefs.headline: BPS baryonic tubes in chiral perturbation theory minimally coupled with electrodynamics and a novel crossover
briefs.text: We derive a novel first-order BPS system (whose solutions are automatically solutions of the second-order field equations) in chiral perturbation theory (CPT) in $(3+1)$ dimensions.

briefs.headline: Second-order localization and intersecting O6-planes in scale-separated AdS vacua
briefs.text: We construct explicit periodic second-order localization corrections to scale-separated AdS$_4$ vacua of massive type IIA supergravity on $T^6/(\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2)$.

briefs.headline: The Matrix in Pieces: Complete BFSS Scattering at Finite Rank
briefs.text: As two matrix blocks separate in Banks-Fischler-Shenker-Susskind matrix quantum mechanics, the modes connecting them develop a growing excitation gap.

briefs.headline: Topological Phase Transition of $ F_{α}{}^{γ} F^{αβ} F_{β}{}^{η} \ F^{λμ} R_{γηλμ} $ AdS Black Holes
briefs.text: We investigate the thermodynamic criticality and topological properties of four-dimensional charged anti-de Sitter black holes in the presence of a nonminimal electromagnetic-curvature interaction of the form \(F_α{}^γF^{αβ}F_β{}^ηF^{λμ}R_{γηλμ}\).

briefs.headline: Refined Rényi Entropy from Replica-Geometry Tensor Networks
briefs.text: Holographic tensor networks are a central route to understanding the mechanism behind the holographic duality, but standard fixed-graph constructions with maximally entangled links face a structural obstacle.

briefs.headline: The Cosmological Constant as a Clock and the Vilenkin Wavefunction as a Resonance
briefs.text: We address the problem of time in quantum gravity using a covariant formulation of unimodular gravity. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Baker-Akhiezer functions for Koornwinder-van Diejen integrable system
briefs.text: The Koornwinder-van Diejen integrable system is a counterpart of the trigonometric Ruijsenaars integrable system (associated with the root system $A_n$) for the root system $(C_n^\vee, C_n)$.

briefs.headline: Resolvent reconstruction of minimal strings beyond KdV II: D series models
briefs.text: Three-state Potts gravity and tetracritical Ising gravity have the same central charge and the same conformal spectral curve.

briefs.headline: A cubic theory of gravity with quasitopological-like properties for compactified cosmologies
briefs.text: We identify a cubic combination of curvature invariants in dimension $D=7$ that when added to the Einstein-Hilbert action, yields a healthy cosmological evolution in four dimensions after compactification on a constant-curvature internal space of dimension three.

briefs.headline: Exact Scalar and Fermionic Propagators in a Uniform Electric Background
briefs.text: By implementing an analytical hybrid framework that combines the Ritus eigenfunction technique with Schwinger's proper-time formalism, we construct exact propagators for charged scalar and fermionic fields in a constant, homogeneous, external electric field in four-dimensional Euclidean space.

briefs.headline: A Kerr-black-hole worldline action to $\mathcal{O}(G^5)$
briefs.text: We establish a worldline action which correctly reproduces Kerr-black-hole dynamics up to fifth order in Newton's constant in a physical post-Minkowskian counting.

briefs.headline: Quantum black hole evaporation from thin shell collapse: a complete effective picture
briefs.text: Quantum gravity is expected to play a central role in resolving classical singularities and providing a complete, predictive spacetime picture. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Holographic ensembles and giant gravitons at the Leigh--Strassler fixed point
briefs.text: Finite-rank observables in holographic quantum field theories provide stringent tests of string and M-theory, but remain challenging to compute when supersymmetry is non-maximal.
briefs.authors: Jesse van Muiden and De-liang Zhong

briefs.headline: Holographic Mutual Information in an Anisotropic Field Theory
briefs.text: We investigate holographic mutual information in an anisotropic strongly coupled plasma within the framework of gauge/gravity duality.

briefs.headline: Entanglement island and Page curve for one-sided rotating Kerr black holes
briefs.text: We investigate the information paradox for one-sided asymptotically flat rotating Kerr black holes formed through gravitational collapse using the island prescription.

briefs.headline: The DBI critical electric field in stationary non-diagonal geometries
briefs.text: We investigate the critical electric field for the holographic Schwinger effect in general stationary non-diagonal geometries.

briefs.headline: Holographic Entanglement Entropy of Network CFT
briefs.text: Miao et al. \cite{Guo:2025sbm, Guo:2026prm} proposed the AdS/NCFT correspondence, which explores the gravity dual of conformal field theories defined on networks.

briefs.headline: Circulating currents around orbifolded defects
briefs.text: We investigate holographic monodromy defects with five dimensional orbifold singularities which lift to smooth and supersymmetric ten dimensional geometries.

briefs.headline: Bootstrapping two-loop $β$-functions for bosonic and heterotic strings
briefs.text: Beyond one loop, $β$-functions of non-linear $σ$-models are hard to compute directly.

briefs.headline: The Eigenfunction Method to Calculate the Klein--Gordon Propa-gator in an Inhomogeneous Magnetic Field
briefs.text: In this paper, we use the Eigenfunction method (Ritus' method) to calculate the Klein--Gordon propagator under an external magnetic field with an exponential damping factor $b$, in a four-dimensional Euclidean space.
briefs.authors: Emerson B. S. Corrê et al.

briefs.headline: New relations of tree-level string amplitudes from the massless prescription
briefs.text: We discover new relations between the string corrections to $(m+1)$-point field-theory amplitudes and $m$-point string amplitudes at tree level from the massless prescription of vertex operators.
